bug_info.bug_desc: In the Active state output decode, scl_temp was unconditionally driven low. When a format FIFO entry with fmt_flag_start_before_i is consumed, the FSM passes through Active before entering SetupStart/HoldStart. During that one-cycle Active pass, SCL is driven low while SDA is still released, producing an I2C SCL low glitch at the beginning of a transaction instead of leaving the bus idle until the START condition. The SCL drive value in Active should depend on whether the current format entry requests a START.
bug_info.fix_hint: Change the Active state output so scl_temp follows fmt_flag_start_before_i: when the start flag is asserted, keep SCL released high while passing through Active; otherwise drive SCL low as before for normal byte/read continuation. This prevents the SCL glitch while preserving the existing behavior for non-START entries.
